verdict.rationale: Drata's open-source agent has read-only access to system preferences to verify screensaver locking, password manager, antivirus and automatic updates (drata-gh-2/3). A community report confirms that employees in the corporate directory without a compliant agent show as noncompliant in the Drata dashboard, which corroborates per-employee tracking (drata-comm-2). The Devices and Personnel APIs, including device ingestion through custom connections, round this out. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of disk-encryption checks, documented MDM integrations (e.g., Jamf/Intune), and first-party docs on the per-employee device compliance view.
